mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 2 months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator for broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals strong consumer demand, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of instances with positive RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the previous month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp and PAYEMS increase > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% over the previous 2 months, it signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 2% QoQ and HOUST increase > 5% in 2 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
